<thought>To locate a template that corresponds to an SN2 transformation, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break an alkyl halide and form a secondary amine, which matches the forward SN2 description. This should return templates that, when applied retrosynthetically, replace a C‑Cl bond with a C‑N bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
